5056095713320.variantName: True Products 2ft Alpine Fir Table Top Artificial Christmas Tree
5056095713320.sourceDescription:
A little tree with plenty of Christmas charm, our 2ft Alpine Fir Artificial Christmas Tree brings a festive touch to shelves, side tables and cosy corners. Nestled in a wicker basket stand, it adds natural texture to your seasonal styling.

At 60cm tall and up to 44cm wide, this tabletop tree is a lovely choice for smaller rooms or as an extra Christmas decoration elsewhere in your home. Its blend of 103 realistic PE tips and 24 PVC tips creates natural-looking foliage, with 127 tips ready to dress with delicate ornaments.

Keep the look simple with a few favourite decorations, or add a string of lights for a gentle festive glow. Supplied without lights, this Alpine Fir gives you the freedom to create a miniature Christmas display that suits your home.

The tree features wrapped branch construction. Gently arrange the branches and individual tips to bring out its shape before adding your finishing touches.

Artificial Christmas Tree
This artificial Christmas tree adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The green finish and plastic and metal construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details
Material: Plastic and Metal. Colour: Green. Stated size: 180 cm. Product weight: 8 kg. Quantity: 1 piece.
Festive green artificial Christmas tree designed to add a decorative focal point to your home holiday display.
Constructed from durable plastic and metal materials for a defined appearance that stands out in any room.
Versatile decoration suitable for creating coordinated groupings or standing alone as a central seasonal feature.
Easy to store and reposition, allowing flexible arrangement adjustments to refresh your festive decor each year.
Guarantee - 1 month
Partial assembly required
With stand

1234550002520.variantName: 2 Pack LED Birch Branch Trees with Warm White Lights, Artificial Lighted Decorative Trees, Illuminated White Branch Tree
1234550002520.sourceDescription:
Create a warm and inviting atmosphere with this 2 Pack LED Birch Branch Trees set. Featuring elegant birch-inspired branches illuminated with beautiful warm white LED lights, these decorative trees add a charming glow to any indoor space. Perfect for Christmas celebrations, weddings, parties and everyday home decoration, they combine a natural tree-inspired appearance with attractive lighting.

Elegant Birch Branch Design

Designed to replicate the natural appearance of birch branches, these decorative lighted trees feature an attractive branch structure that adds a stylish and contemporary touch to your home. Their elegant design complements a variety of interior decorating styles.

Warm White LED Lighting

The integrated warm white LED lights create a soft and welcoming glow, helping transform your surroundings into a cosy and relaxing space. They make an attractive decorative feature for both everyday displays and special occasions.

Convenient 2 Pack Set

Supplied as a set of two decorative LED birch trees, they can be displayed together for a coordinated arrangement or positioned separately in different areas of your home.

Versatile Indoor Decoration

Ideal for living rooms, bedrooms, hallways, windowsills and decorative corners. These illuminated trees are also suitable for weddings, Christmas celebrations, birthday parties and other special events.

Stylish Decorative Lighting

Combining decorative branches with integrated LED illumination, these artificial trees provide an attractive alternative to traditional decorative lamps and seasonal ornaments.
2 PACK LED BIRCH TREES – Includes two artificial birch branch trees with integrated LED lights, offering a coordinated decorative display for your home or special occasions.
WARM WHITE LED LIGHTS – Features beautiful warm white illumination that creates a soft, cosy and welcoming atmosphere, making these decorative trees suitable for day and evening displays.
REALISTIC BIRCH BRANCH DESIGN – Designed with attractive birch-inspired branches to bring a natural and elegant appearance to your indoor decorations.
VERSATILE HOME DECORATION – Ideal for living rooms, bedrooms, hallways, windowsills and other indoor spaces, adding a decorative lighting feature to different areas of your home.
PERFECT FOR SPECIAL OCCASIONS – Suitable for Christmas, weddings, birthday parties, celebrations and festive events, helping create an attractive decorative setting.
STYLISH ILLUMINATED DISPLAY – Combines artificial tree branches with integrated LED lighting to create an eye-catching decorative feature for modern and traditional interiors.
DISPLAY TOGETHER OR SEPARATELY – The two-piece set allows flexible placement, whether arranged together as a matching display or positioned in separate indoor areas.
DECORATIVE FESTIVE LIGHTING – Adds an elegant finishing touch to seasonal decorations and everyday interior displays, making it a versatile decorative addition to your home.

Brighten your holiday decoration with festive charm!
This festive tabletop piece brings cheerful character and practical glow to seasonal spaces. Styled with a Santa-inspired red hat, soft white nose, and red glove accents, it creates the charm of a decorated Christmas tree while fitting neatly on desks, mantels, and entry tables. With 105 snowy PVC branch tips, the silhouette looks fuller and more textured, adding a cozy winter touch without taking up much room. The 20 warm white LED lights give this pre-lit small Xmas tree a welcoming sparkle, and 8 lighting modes (combination, in waves, sequential, slo glo, chasing/flash, fade, twinkle/flash, steady on) make it easy to match quiet evenings or lively holiday gatherings. Battery-powered design supports flexible placement, while the timer function runs 6 hours on and 18 hours off for everyday convenience. Premium PVC tips are flame-retardant, fade-resistant, smell-free, and non-allergic, making this mini tabletop Christmas tree a dependable indoor decoration for homes, offices, kids, and pets.
Note: Battery box requires 3 AA batteries, not included.

5071948845720.sourceDescription:
Christmas Baubles
Add colour and detail to your Christmas tree with these decorative baubles. Their hanging format lets you spread the ornaments through the branches or combine them with other suitable festive displays for a coordinated seasonal arrangement.

Hanging Cord
The hanging cord gives the ornament a defined attachment point for a suitable support. It allows the decorative face to remain visible and makes it easy to include the piece among other hanging accents in the intended display.

Shatter Resistant Design
The ornaments use a shatter resistant construction for the stated decorative use. They provide an alternative to traditional glass decorations when arranging the display, while retaining a defined shape and finish for the festive setting.

Lightweight Design
The lightweight form is convenient to handle and move between suitable locations. It also makes the item easier to include when organising a bag or storage space.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Product details
Material: Plastic. Colour: Gold. Product measurements: length 24 cm, width 24 cm, height 6 cm. Product weight: 0.4 kg. Quantity: 1 set.
Shatter resistant plastic construction provides safe, durable festive decoration.
Includes a hanging cord for easy attachment to tree branches or displays.
Lightweight design ensures convenient handling and simple storage between seasons.
Gold finish adds a classic, elegant touch to your Christmas tree arrangement.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Resistant to shattering
Included: 1 set of Christmas baubles
Hanger included

5056903233620.sourceDescription:
Add champagne colour and contrasting texture to your Christmas decorations with this pack of 6 matching 10cm thread ball baubles. Each round ornament has a thread-wrapped surface with an iridescent sequin band around the middle, bringing together fine lines and reflective detail in one design. A hanging loop above the decorative cap provides a way to position the bauble on a suitable tree branch or include it in a wreath or garland arrangement. The 10cm size creates a visible accent among foliage, ribbons and other hanging ornaments, while the champagne finish helps you coordinate a consistent seasonal colour scheme. Use the matching pieces to repeat the design across the tree, or combine with your own plain and patterned decorations for a varied display. These Christmas tree ornaments also work in indoor window arrangements, mantel greenery, winter wedding decorations and festive party displays. This option contains 6 baubles, with the same thread covering and sequin-band design on each piece. Display the band facing forward so its sequin detail remains visible between branches.
Thread Ball Baubles: Includes 6 matching 10cm champagne Christmas tree baubles, with a thread-wrapped surface and an iridescent sequin band around the middle. The round ornaments add colour and texture to Christmas tree decorations, wreaths and garlands, with the same finish on each selected piece.
Sequin Band Detail: The iridescent band contrasts with the champagne thread covering, combining a textured finish with reflective sequin detail. Place these decorative Christmas balls among foliage and ribbons to add a different surface beside plain baubles in your seasonal arrangement.
Hanging Tree Ornaments: A loop above the decorative cap provides a hanging point for each bauble. Position the 10cm ornaments on suitable branches or incorporate them into a wreath or garland, spacing them between other decorations so the thread texture and sequin band remain visible.
Coordinated Christmas Decor: Use the champagne colour to build a consistent tree theme, or combine the baubles with contrasting ornaments and ribbon. The round shape suits traditional Christmas decorations, winter wedding displays and festive party arrangements around the home.
Display And Pack Contents: Includes 6 matching decorative balls for a repeated accent, each measuring 10cm. Add to indoor window arrangements, mantel greenery or a decorated tree, then coordinate with your own bows, foliage and seasonal accessories for a display throughout the festive season.

5056463974520.sourceDescription:
Add a playful gingerbread house theme to your Christmas decorating with this Foldable Paper Rope Tree Collar. Designed to surround the base of a suitable Christmas tree, the decorative cover features charming house-inspired details, including arched windows, a heart-shaped door and white rope accents that resemble traditional gingerbread decoration. The woven paper rope construction creates a natural textured appearance, bringing a warm rustic character to your festive display. Its lightweight yet structured design helps conceal the tree stand and provides a neat finishing touch beneath hanging ornaments and Christmas lights. Measuring approximately L43 x W43 x H25.4cm, the collar offers a compact decorative surround for compatible Christmas tree bases. Unlike bulky fixed tree covers, the practical folding construction allows it to collapse flat after the festive season, making storage easier until the following Christmas. Suitable for traditional, rustic and gingerbread-inspired Christmas themes, this reusable tree collar provides an attractive alternative to conventional fabric skirts while keeping the lower tree area neatly decorated.
CHARMING GINGERBREAD TREE DECORATION: Give your Christmas tree a distinctive finishing touch with a gingerbread house-inspired collar featuring decorative arched windows, a heart door motif and contrasting white rope detailing.
NATURAL TEXTURED PAPER ROPE: Woven paper rope creates an attractive rustic appearance around the tree base, bringing warmth and decorative texture to Christmas displays while complementing traditional festive colour schemes and ornaments.
CONCEALS THE CHRISTMAS TREE STAND: Structured collar surrounds the lower section of a compatible tree, helping cover the stand area and providing a neat decorative alternative to loose fabric tree skirts or exposed supporting frames.
FOLDS FLAT AFTER THE FESTIVE SEASON: Convenient collapsible design makes the collar easier to store when Christmas decorating is finished, reducing the space required in cupboards or seasonal decoration storage containers.
PRACTICAL 43 X 43 X 25.4CM DIMENSIONS: Approximately 43cm long, 43cm wide and 25.4cm high, making it suitable for compatible tree bases. Measure your existing Christmas tree stand before ordering to check that the collar will fit.

5056797097520.baseName: MySmartBuy Twinkling Pre-Lit Christmas Tree, Copper Gold LED Black Frame
5056797097520.variantName: MySmartBuy Twinkling Pre-Lit Christmas Tree, Copper Gold LED Black Frame
5056797097520.sourceDescription:
Add a magical twinkle to your Christmas display with this pre-lit tree from MySmartBuy. Lit with copper gold effect LEDs and finished with a 10% twinkle effect, it shimmers gently all evening, creating a cosy, enchanting glow that draws the eye from across the room or the street. Choose from four sizes to suit your space: 1.8m, 2.5m, 3.05m or 3.6m, with up to 1080 LEDs on the largest tree. The durable black frame keeps its shape season after season and fades into the background after dark. Suitable for indoor and outdoor use, the smaller sizes suit hallways and living rooms, while the taller trees make a spectacular centrepiece for gardens, driveways and commercial displays. It is supplied with a 5m lead cable, giving plenty of reach from your socket, and the built-in timer lights it for 6 hours and then switches it off for 18 hours, so it comes on at the same time every evening without you needing to remember. Light up trees are a clever way to add festive height and impact without the mess of a real tree. Use one as a centrepiece, place a pair either side of a doorway, or combine different sizes to create a glowing forest effect in the garden or a large room. A show-stopping alternative to a traditional tree, it brings instant festive impact with none of the needles, and can be enjoyed year after year. At a glance: copper gold effect LEDs with 10% twinkle | 1.8m, 2.5m, 3.05m or 3.6m | up to 1080 LEDs | black frame | 5m lead cable | 6 hours on / 18 hours off timer | indoor and outdoor use.
TWINKLING PRE-LIT TREE : Copper gold effect LEDs with a 10% twinkle effect for a gentle, enchanting shimmer all evening.
FOUR SIZES : Available in 1.8m, 2.5m, 3.05m and 3.6m, with up to 1080 LEDs, on a durable black frame.
5M LEAD CABLE : Supplied with a 5m lead cable, giving plenty of reach from your socket to your chosen spot.
AUTOMATIC TIMER : Built-in 6 hours on / 18 hours off timer, so it lights up at the same time every evening without you having to remember.
INDOOR AND OUTDOOR USE : Smaller sizes suit hallways and living rooms; taller trees make a spectacular garden or commercial centrepiece.

5063536223720.sourceDescription:
Crown your Christmas tree with a gold topper that lights up from the top down. Choose the Flower, Star or Starburst design to suit your tree and your style.

Each topper carries 20 warm white LEDs on a fine wire, so the light glows softly through the branches. A switch turns it on and off, and holding the button keeps the warm white light on steadily. The timer runs 6 hours on and 18 hours off, which keeps the lights on through the evening without you needing to switch them.

The two AA batteries are not included, so you will need to supply them before use. The battery pack sits on the cable, so it can be tucked out of sight behind the tree. Use it for a tree, mantelpiece or hallway display through the festive season.
Overall size: Flower: 30cm H x 24cm W x 5.5cm D; Starburst: 31.5cm H x 22.5cm W x 5cm D; Star: 32cm H x 21cm W x 5cm D

Delivery: Single parcel

Timer Function
A timer provides a way to organise the operating period. Set the available timing option to suit the activity and adjust it when your routine changes.

Pine Cone Detail
Pine cone details add texture among the festive foliage. Their recognisable shapes help create a woodland inspired arrangement, making the decoration easy to coordinate with other natural looking Christmas accessories.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture

5096042277420.variantName: Christmas wreath - Christmas door wreath - Two wreaths with flexible branch tips for hanging on a door or wall - Green, 50 cm
5096042277420.sourceDescription:
Each wreath is built on a metal frame with 95 flexible artificial branch tips. The two green rings measure 50 cm across and 13 cm deep, giving you matching shapes to dress alike or decorate in two different colours.

A wreath puts the decoration on the door or wall itself, leaving the console or mantelpiece below free for cards and winter flowers. Its outline is complete in one piece, which is handy in an entrance where there is little space for a tree. Arrange the outer tips first to establish the silhouette, then turn a few of the inner branches to fill gaps. Looking at the shape straight on makes it easier to see where a little adjustment is useful.

For an entrance used throughout the day, use a fixing suited to the door finish and the weight of the decoration. A trial positioning helps you check the view from both sides of an open door before committing to a spot. If you already have a busy Christmas tree, give the wreath a space of its own. A quiet patch of wall brings the outline into focus and gives visitors a chance to see the individual details as they pass.

If you plan to use the wreath in a group, set it out with your other decorations before you hang them. A little breathing room around its edge usually shows the shapes more clearly than placing several pieces edge to edge. After the festive season, lay the decoration in a box with space around its edges. Keep heavy ornaments and tightly coiled strings of lights separate so that the front of the wreath keeps its shape in storage.

On a mantel wall, the wreath can sit above the display while the shelf below stays clear for cards and small ornaments. Leave a little space between the top of the cards and the bottom of the wreath so their outlines remain distinct. Hung on a panelled door, a wreath looks best when the edges of the panel still show.
Includes two matching green wreaths for versatile door or wall decoration.
Features a sturdy metal frame with 95 flexible artificial branch tips per wreath.
Compact design measures 50 cm in diameter and 13 cm deep for easy hanging.
Flexible tips allow easy shaping to create a full, natural festive silhouette.

Welcome guests and brighten your home with this beautiful artificial wreath. Designed for year-round appeal or seasonal celebrations, it offers a lasting, low-maintenance alternative to fresh flowers. It provides an immediate decorative lift to any door, wall, or mantelpiece, setting a warm and inviting tone.

Crafted from high-quality, durable materials, this wreath is designed to resist fading and maintain its shape season after season. The foliage, berries, and floral elements are carefully arranged on a sturdy, natural-looking twig base, creating a full and realistic appearance. This robust construction ensures it can be stored and reused for multiple holidays. Unlike natural wreaths, it requires no watering or maintenance and will not shed needles or petals, making it a clean and practical choice.

This wreath is available in two versatile sizes. The 25cm option is perfect for smaller doors or interior walls, while the larger 34cm version makes a substantial statement on a front door or above a fireplace. Both sizes feature a approx 7cm depth, giving them a rich, three-dimensional profile that adds texture and visual interest to any flat surface.

Imagine the welcoming sight this wreath provides as you return home, or the festive atmosphere it creates during a family gathering. It’s an effortless way to mark the changing seasons, whether celebrating the fresh start of spring or the cosy warmth of the winter holidays. This single piece simplifies your seasonal changeover, allowing you to instantly refresh your home's ambiance.

Christmas Garland
This Christmas garland adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The green finish and PVC construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Water Resistant
The water resistant construction is useful where occasional moisture is part of the intended use. Allow damp surfaces to dry after use and follow the stated limits for exposure.

Reusable Design
The reusable format is intended to be used again after suitable care. Keep it clean and store it between uses so it remains ready for the next occasion.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.
